name: eBay used Tesla V100 32GB PCIe card
price_basis: ASKING price. $695-900 passive PCIe card Oct-2026 (HPE P05913-001 $694.99, HP PG500-216 $809-899, Dell pulls ~$758). Midpoint-ish recorded. notes: The low-drama V100 route - plain PCIe x16, no carrier needed, 250 W passive dual-slot (needs airflow mod for desktop). PCIe premium (~$300-350 over bare SXM2 module) buys the carrier problem solved. Volta FP16 tensor (112 TF) means vLLM FP16 works properly - real advantage over every Pascal part. Best first buy for a homelab at this price.
